info.title: TensorCost
info.description: Check a budget before an expensive step, record what an AI call cost, read a team's budget room, and start a flow when a budget crosses an alert threshold. For flows and Copilot Studio agents that make model calls with their own provider keys.

post.description: Ask TensorCost whether a step fits the budgets. Branch on Decision: allow and reroute both mean go ahead as asked, refuse means stop and show Message. A refusal is a normal answer, not an error. Set this action's retry policy to None: asking twice for one step holds its cost twice.

200.description: A decision. A refusal is also a 200.

default.description: TensorCost couldn't answer. Follow your own fail mode.

post.description: Give back the hold of a step that provably never ran: the flow stopped before calling the provider, or the provider refused the call before doing any work (a 401, 403, 404 or 429). Never use it after a timeout, a 5xx, a 400, a retry or anything else that may have billed: cancelling lets other calls spend money the hard cap still has to count. Without a cancel the hold lapses after five minutes. Set this action's retry policy to None.

parameters.name: decision_id
parameters.description: The Decision ID that Check budget returned.

200.description: Done, whether or not there was a hold to cancel.

default.description: TensorCost couldn't answer. The hold lapses on its own.

post.description: Send one model call's tokens to TensorCost. Only for calls made with your own provider keys: a model that Microsoft bills, such as the AI Builder and Copilot Studio credits, isn't counted here. Log ID decides whether a retry counts the call once, so build it from what is unique to the call: concat('pp:', Decision ID) when the step was checked, else concat('pp:', Provider response ID), else guid(). With a guid() a re-run of the flow can count the call twice.

default.description: TensorCost couldn't take the row. Sending it again is safe: the same Log ID counts once.

post.description: How much room the budgets have for a team, a person or a step that costs about Estimate. Nothing is held. Leave everything out to ask about the whole workspace.

200.description: The budgets that apply and what is left of each.

post.summary: When a budget crosses an alert threshold
post.description: Starts the flow when one of the workspace's budgets crosses an alert threshold. The flow subscribes when it is turned on and unsubscribes when it is turned off or deleted.

201.description: Subscribed. The platform deletes the subscription at the path in Location.

x-ms-notification-content.description: A budget crossed an alert threshold.

kind.description: environment: the Power Platform environment's ID. user: a person's email. tag: key=value, such as team=search or cost-center=7.

id.description: The environment ID, the email, or the key=value tag.

Callers.description: Who the step is for. Send the flow's environment ID as kind environment (in a flow: workflow()['tags']['environmentName']), the person's email as kind user, and the team as kind tag with the value team=<team name or slug>. Use the same callers in Check budget and Record AI spend so the spend lands on the team its check was made for.

model.description: The model the step will call, as its provider names it.

provider.description: anthropic, openai, aws.bedrock, azure.ai.openai, gcp.vertex_ai... An unknown provider skips provider budgets.

max_tokens.description: The output allowance. The hold is sized from it.

input_tokens.description: The prompt's size, if you can count it. With Max tokens it makes the hold the step's worst case.

workflow_id.description: The flow's ID, for reports. In a flow: workflow()['name'].

agent_id.description: The Copilot Studio agent running the step, if any.

customer.description: The end customer the step is for, the same ID your apps send TensorCost as x-tc-customer. The check is judged against that customer's limits. Send it in Record AI spend too.

can_reroute.description: A flow can't rewrite a step's model, so this is always false.

decision.description: allow or reroute: go ahead as asked. refuse: stop.

decision_id.description: Pass to Record AI spend so the spend releases this hold.

message.description: What to show the person. A refusal names the budget and who can raise it.

degraded.description: True when the step was decided without a full check.

unmapped.description: Callers TensorCost has no alias for yet, as alias kind:value.

cancelled.description: False when there was nothing to cancel: the decision held nothing, was already cancelled, had expired, or isn't this connection's.

log_id.description: This row's own ID; a row sent again with the same ID counts once. Use concat('pp:', Decision ID), else concat('pp:', Provider response ID), else guid().

input_tokens.description: All input tokens, cache reads and writes included.

cached_input_tokens.description: Of the input tokens, those read from the provider's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Of the input tokens, those written to the cache.

provider_response_id.description: The provider's own ID for the response (OpenAI's id, Anthropic's msg_...). It lets TensorCost count the call once if its bill or invocation log also shows it.

correlation_id.description: The Decision ID from Check budget, if the step was checked. It ties this spend to the check and releases its hold.

status.description: success or failure, or the HTTP status.

upstream_status.description: The provider's own HTTP status, if you have it.

customer.description: The end customer the call was for, as in Check budget. The call counts toward that customer.

logs.description: The calls to record. One row per call.

deduped.description: Rows already stored under the same Log ID.

skipped.description: Rows TensorCost read but didn't keep, such as a call that was never billed.

parse_errors.description: Rows TensorCost couldn't read. Check this: a row in this list was not recorded.

team.description: The TensorCost team's name, slug or ID. Wins over the team the callers resolve to.

developer.description: The person's email. Their team is used when they are on exactly one.

estimate_cents.description: What the step is expected to cost. Leave out or 0 to ask only whether a hard cap is already at its limit.

allowed.description: False when the estimate would take a hard cap over, or one is at its limit or not counted yet.

api_key.name: Authorization
api_key.description: Bearer followed by your TensorCost gateway key: Bearer tcgw_...
